limitations: These four original local full-legal-search profiles are proxies, not the official Championship agents. Outcomes do not estimate hidden-grader win rates. Fixtures are deterministic and correlated, and each is run once per source, opponent, and own color. Opening moves are forced and included in the 24-move game limit. Node budgets allow reproducible search work but are not equal CPU budgets. CPU budgets and timings are in-process and machine/load dependent; hard timeout is checked by benchmark.run_game. Heldout means a separate literal fixture set, not a claim that its outcomes have never been inspected. Search APIs are exercised directly; this does not test file protocol or whole-game budget allocation.
